list: The official 55 trophies, frozen 2026-11-18. Names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them, via the Exophase and PSNProfiles listings, which agree on all three.

sources.EXO: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PSN) trophy list: official names, descriptions, grades, hidden flags
sources.PSNP: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list: grades and the progress targets PlayStation tracks
sources.PSN: The official PlayStation trophy description itself, quoted in each entry's description field
sources.OWN: This guide's own words, derived from the official description; anything not pinned down by it is marked confidence=derived or unconfirmed, never presented as checked in-game

countedNote: 20 trophies carry a numeric target in their official description; each is stored as target+unit so the tracker can count progress toward it.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum: earn the other 54 trophies and this unlocks on its own. Plan the run around it — finish the story first, then the counted grinds, then the 100% checklist — because every other trophy on this list feeds it. Sources: Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official list; the order is this guide's own, from the official descriptions.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the opening mission, Gone Fishing. Play the campaign from the start and it unlocks as that mission ends; nothing else is required and there is no side condition to prepare. Sources: the official description (PSN), cross-checked on Exophase.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission of Chapter 1. It unlocks on chapter completion during a normal story playthrough, so no collectible or activity work is needed first. Sources: the official description (PSN), cross-checked on Exophase.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every mission of Chapter 2. The name is printed exactly as PlayStation publishes it, asterisks included. Unlocks on chapter completion in story order. Sources: the official description (PSN), cross-checked on Exophase.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every mission of Chapter 3. Unlocks on chapter completion in story order; bank your Chapter 1–2 side progress first if you are pacing the counted trophies alongside the campaign. Sources: the official description (PSN), cross-checked on Exophase.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every mission of Chapter 4, the last numbered chapter before the endgame missions. Unlocks on chapter completion in story order. Sources: the official description (PSN), cross-checked on Exophase.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Gold story trophy for completing the final mission. Missable watch (derived, not confirmed): before starting the finale, clear any one-off partner and location trophies you still need, because the official list gives no promise of a post-ending free roam. Sources: the official description (PSN); the caution is this guide's own, from that silence.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the named story mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks when that mission ends during the campaign; no optional condition is attached to it in the official list. Sources: the official description (PSN), cross-checked on Exophase.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the named story mission The Cartel Heist. Unlocks on mission completion in campaign order. Sources: the official description (PSN), cross-checked on Exophase.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the named story mission Child's Play. Unlocks on mission completion in campaign order. Sources: the official description (PSN), cross-checked on Exophase.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the named story mission Headliners. Unlocks on mission completion in campaign order. Sources: the official description (PSN), cross-checked on Exophase.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the named story mission VCIA Takedown, set at VCIA. While you are at VCIA for this mission, note the separate one-off trophy Catch Me If You Can, which also names VCIA — its window may be tied to story access. Sources: the official descriptions (PSN) of both trophies; the pairing is this guide's own.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the named story mission Operation Savage Glory. Unlocks on mission completion in campaign order. Sources: the official description (PSN), cross-checked on Exophase.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Gold trophy for 100% game completion. Treat it as the master checklist: the counted trophies on this list (250 stunts, 42 range golds, 8 stranger strands, the collectible sets) are the grind-shaped parts of that 100%, so track them here and let this trophy close last, just before the platinum. Sources: the official description (PSN); target as tracked by PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts — a pure counter, so spread it across the whole playthrough instead of grinding it at the end: take stunt opportunities as you cross Leonida and let the tracker counter climb with natural travel. Silver grade. Sources: the official description (PSN); target as tracked by PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — breadth, not mastery. Use it as an early sampler: one attempt at every activity type also shows you which counted grinds (races, ranges, drone courses) you will be returning to. Sources: the official description (PSN); the count of 9 activity types as listed with the trophy on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Silver grade and one of the skill grinds: work the ranges as they open rather than saving all 42 for the cleanup phase, and count golds in the tracker as you go. Note a live dispute among published guides on how the 42 split across venues — the total of 42 is what the official tracking counts, and it is the total this guide relies on. Sources: the official description (PSN); target as tracked by PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations — a win per location, not just an entry. Tick each location off in the tracker as the win lands so the last missing course is easy to find. Sources: the official description (PSN); the count of 14 locations as listed with the trophy on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — re-winning the same race does not advance the counter, so move across the race list instead of farming a favourite. Sources: the official description (PSN); target as tracked by PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge — a single head-to-head win, not a grind. Take it when the fishing challenge is offered rather than postponing it; fishing is also one of the activity types that feeds Master of None. Sources: the official description (PSN), cross-checked on Exophase.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game, start to finish — a single completion, and also one of the activity types behind Master of None. Sources: the official description (PSN), cross-checked on Exophase.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's mission strand through to its final mission. Missable watch (derived, not confirmed): strand finals depend on starting and advancing the strand, so begin Andy's missions when they appear instead of leaving every strand to the endgame. One of the strands counted by Strangers & Freaks. Sources: the official descriptions (PSN) of both trophies; the caution is this guide's own.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's mission strand through to its final mission. Missable watch (derived, not confirmed): start and advance the strand when it appears rather than stockpiling strands for the cleanup phase. One of the strands counted by Strangers & Freaks. Sources: the official descriptions (PSN) of both trophies; the caution is this guide's own.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's mission strand through to its final mission. Missable watch (derived, not confirmed): start and advance the strand when it appears. One of the strands counted by Strangers & Freaks. Sources: the official descriptions (PSN) of both trophies; the caution is this guide's own.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Silver trophy for completing 8 stranger mission strands anywhere in Leonida. The named strand finals on this list — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone — are the visible backbone of the count; finish strands fully rather than opening many and closing none. Sources: the official description (PSN); target as tracked by PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's mission strand through to its final mission. Missable watch (derived, not confirmed): start and advance the strand when it appears. One of the strands counted by Strangers & Freaks. Sources: the official descriptions (PSN) of both trophies; the caution is this guide's own.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's mission strand through to its final mission. Missable watch (derived, not confirmed): start and advance the strand when it appears. One of the strands counted by Strangers & Freaks. Sources: the official descriptions (PSN) of both trophies; the caution is this guide's own.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida — a map-wide collectible sweep. Pair it with The Goodtime State's area exploration so each district trip banks both counters at once. Sources: the official description (PSN); the count of 18 spots as listed with the trophy on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Missable watch (derived, not confirmed): it hangs on Bret's strand, so take his missions when they appear and finish the hunt before treating the strand as done. Sources: the official description (PSN); the caution is this guide's own.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Silver trophy for completing 3 full Collectible Card sets. Collect by set, not by wandering: finish one set before scattering effort across the others, and count sets — not loose cards — in the tracker. Sources: the official description (PSN); target as tracked by PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Silver trophy: use WAiNK at 100 locations. A long map counter — fold it into every district trip alongside meditation spots and area discovery so the 100 accumulate as a by-product of travel you already owe. Sources: the official description (PSN); target as tracked by PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Keep a running count in the tracker and prefer challenges that overlap other counters (races, ranges, stunts) so each completion pays twice. Sources: the official description (PSN); target as tracked by PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, raise a 4-star wanted level, then lose it and escape. Missable watch (derived, not confirmed): it needs your partner present, so do it during the campaign while the partner is with you rather than assuming a post-story chance. Sources: the official description (PSN); the timing caution is this guide's own.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, keeping the wanted level alive between shops — chain nearby shops and do not break the heat in between. Missable watch (derived, not confirmed): it needs your partner, so attempt it during the campaign. Sources: the official description (PSN); the timing caution is this guide's own.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Variety is the whole job: swap cars as you travel instead of keeping one favourite, and the counter climbs with normal play. Pairs naturally with On the Spot's 10 Scooter Bros registrations. Sources: the official description (PSN); target as tracked by PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies inside one Combat Focus activation. Save the attempt for a crowded fight rather than spending Focus on one or two targets at a time. Sources: the official description (PSN), cross-checked on Exophase.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — leave the airport in a way the schedule never planned. Missable watch (derived, not confirmed): VCIA is named in the story mission VCIA Takedown, so try this while story access puts you at VCIA rather than assuming free-roam access later. Sources: the official descriptions (PSN) of both trophies; the pairing and caution are this guide's own.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed: the official description only jokes about Rhinos — the game's tanks — and pins down no exact action. Honest position: expect a Rhino encounter (survive it, ride in one, or destroy one are the readings published guides debate) and do not trust any guide that states one as settled fact. This entry will be updated when a sourced account agrees. Sources: the official description (PSN); uncertainty stated by this guide.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — the whole attempt is the stealth condition, so plan the quiet entry and exit before touching anything, and restart the attempt rather than finishing it loud. Sources: the official description (PSN), cross-checked on Exophase.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Silver trophy: rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each. Count vaults in the tracker — an escape is part of every one of the five, so a vault that ends in arrest banks nothing. Sources: the official description (PSN); target as tracked by PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob one armored truck and escape — a single successful job, escape included. Sources: the official description (PSN), cross-checked on Exophase.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Run it as the map spine of the cleanup phase: every district trip should also bank meditation spots, WAiNK locations and vehicle discoveries. Sources: the official description (PSN); the count of 52 areas as listed with the trophy on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — one per gang, so track gangs, not robberies: a second operation from the same gang adds nothing. Sources: the official description (PSN); the count of 9 gangs as listed with the trophy on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — the one trophy whose official description names its place outright. Do it on your first Ocean Beach visit and bank it early. The name ends with the ellipsis character exactly as PlayStation publishes it. Sources: the official description (PSN), cross-checked on Exophase.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in a vehicle — through the glass, in classic style, as the description puts it. Derived reading: take a showroom car and drive it out through the frontage rather than walking out. Sources: the official description (PSN); the reading is this guide's own, from that wording.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — bowl at that named alley. Bowling is also an activity type, so the visit can pay into Master of None at the same time. The name uses the curly apostrophe exactly as PlayStation publishes it. Sources: the official description (PSN), cross-checked on Exophase.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed: the official description — 'A partnership with mass appeal' — names no action, place or count. Honest position: it is a partner-themed one-off whose exact trigger published sources have not yet agreed on; this guide states no invented step for it. Sources: the official description (PSN); uncertainty stated by this guide.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices — PlayStation tracks this to 500, so it is a long-tail counter that fills in across a full playthrough rather than a single action to hunt down. If it lags late, favour choice-heavy interactions over free roam. Sources: the official description (PSN); the tracked count of 500 as listed on PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed: the official description — 'Second time's the charm' — implies succeeding at something on a second attempt after a first failure, but names neither the activity nor the place. Honest position: no settled sourced trigger yet; this guide invents none. Sources: the official description (PSN); uncertainty stated by this guide.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed: the official description — 'What the hell just happened?' — points at witnessing something strange, with no place or trigger stated. Honest position: treat it as a scripted-strangeness trophy you meet by playing, not a location to camp; no sourced pinpoint exists yet. Sources: the official description (PSN); uncertainty stated by this guide.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl someone over with a melee drive-by — strike a pedestrian target with a melee attack from a moving vehicle, as the description's bowling joke spells out. A one-off: line up a clean pass rather than a crash. Sources: the official description (PSN), cross-checked on Exophase.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts — route marked bills to contacts as a habit, not a finale, so the quarter-million accumulates across the campaign's crime work. Sources: the official description (PSN); target as tracked by PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in total. It fills naturally if you buy as you go; if it lags, it is one of the safest late grinds because spending is always available. Sources: the official description (PSN); target as tracked by PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. A money-gated checklist: keep enough cash unspent late in the run, and count properties in the tracker as each purchase lands. Sources: the official description (PSN); the count of 8 garages as listed with the trophy on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Pair it with Whip It Good: every new vehicle you discover is a registration candidate, so register as you discover and both counters climb together. Sources: the official description (PSN); target as tracked by PSNProfiles.
